messages:
Alex: Quick check — next week's ArchBoard needs a session owner for Wed 9am PT. I'm OOO Tue-Wed. Agenda draft at bottom. @Sasha @Miguel any chance you can take the slot?

Sasha: I can take it if no one else. Would prefer to split hosting with Miguel. :+1:

Miguel: I can do the first half (RFC reviews) and handoff to Sasha for design deep-dive. Works for me.

Kate: FYI we've got a platform triage with infra at 10am, might overlap if we run over. Can we cap to 45m?

Jing: Agenda suggestion — move the KV-cache RFC to the start (context heavy), then 15m for smart-routing rolling fallback (demo), last 10m for open triage.

Alex: Proposed format: 45m total — 25m RFCs (2x10 + 5m quick notes), 15m design review, 5m action items + owners. Vote with reactions?

Miguel: SGTM. I'll prep a 5-slide summary for the KV-cache RFC. Sasha, do you want me to drop the slides in the meeting thread before handoff?

Sasha: Yes please — post by EOD Tuesday. I'll own the design deck and the demo runbook.

devops-bot: deploys scheduled: infra-rollout at Wed 09:30 PT — warning posted to #incidents. Please confirm scheduling won't conflict.

Kate: Thanks @devops-bot — if the rollout looks risky we should move the session to 11am. For now assume 45m and stay flexible.

Alex: OK locking Wed 09:00 PT, 45m. Hosts: Miguel (first 25m), Sasha (15m + wrap). Sasha/Miguel please post slides + runbook by Tue EOD. I'll update the calendar invite and add the "pre-reads" section.

Sasha: Will do. Adding checklist: pre-reads link, open questions list, and a short "what to look for" note for reviewers.

Miguel: Added slides to thread: https://redwood.example/slides/kv-cache-v2

Jing: Minor ask — include perf numbers (p99 latency) in the slides.

Sasha: Added perf table.

Alex: Thanks all. If anything changes ping here. :tada:
